verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Instinct acting proactively on its own initiative: it follows up on dropped threads, calls or texts the user, and once booked an overdue appointment. Nothing documents a way for users to define event-triggered rules or automations. Vendor-driven proactivity and a reviewer delegating ongoing follow-ups are adjacent behaviors, not user-defined trigger→action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
